scope: Display-space survey in actual longitude/latitude km; not historical classification or full history validation

method.sampling: 0..100 normalized replay at1-point intervals plus exact declared/window boundaries and immediately-before exit; no game-day interpretation
method.visibility: Only concurrently visible units contribute to an instant. allTime unions those instants and is never called simultaneous.
method.distance: Great-circle sphere radius6371.0088km, diagnostic approximation. bbox width at midlatitude/height at midlongitude; maxPair sampled positions only. Display3decimal rounding is not historical accuracy.
method.context: No active game state; opponent-home lookup returns null. Estimated placement/motion may differ in a running save. Recorded anchors and explicit phase reference retained separately.
method.samplingLimit: Sampled maxima are lower bounds;1 replay-point intervals can miss continuous wobble extrema. Explicit phase source vertices are separately reported, not promoted into recorded concurrent positions.
method.thresholds: No small/medium/large thresholds inferred. Unknown troops are not zero. No new source claims.
